title: 5-Minute Prep French Onion Baked Chicken
cookTime: about 40-45 minutes (30 min covered + 10-15 min uncovered)
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, sliced into thinner cutlets or pounded to an even thickness
1 (10.5 oz) can condensed French onion soup
instructions: If chicken breasts are thick, slice in half horizontally to create thinner cutlets or pound to an even thickness.
Pour the French onion soup into the bottom of a baking dish.
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder and arrange over the soup.
Spread the French onion dip over the chicken.
Top with crushed croutons, then add the provolone cheese slices.
Cover with foil and bake for about 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake another 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden and the chicken reaches 165°F internally.
notes: Author (Whitney Kai Lyn / 'asa palette cafe · A sprinkle of happiness') noted in comments that if sodium is a concern it's fine to skip this recipe rather than substitute. Commenters suggested variations: Durkee fried onions or stuffing mix instead of croutons for a different texture, and boneless pork chops as a chicken substitute.
